title: Camps — pass 1, step 1: the small fixes (S-8, R2-07, R2-03, S-2, R4-06)
subtitle: The fixes the design review’s rolling check found, that you already decided on 2026-11-04 (v1.043, v1.047, v1.048, v1.051). No database change. Real preview data; the “After” changes are drawn on top of the real screens for this picture only. Amber = what changes. 1 S-8: the camp’s ⋯ starts with Close / Open sign-up, then Edit camp (as Star, Black Belt and Color Belt). 2 R2-07: the Undo of Close sign-up says sign-up is open again. 3 R2-03: restoring a “Duplicate copy” has no Undo (an Undo would remove the row as plain “Removed”, with “Withdrawn” in its history); other restores keep it. 4–5 S-2: five reads that fail now offer Retry (it repeats the same read). 6 R4-06: the family page’s week title drops to weight 500.

footer:
Tablet 820 touch and PC: the camp list’s row has its own Edit pencil, so its ⋯ has no Edit camp and doesn’t change (1); the header ⋯ changes the same way at every size. Toasts, bars and the Retry button are the shared parts, so 820 and 320 look like these; the design reviewer checks all four sizes after the build.
Also in this step, words only (nothing to draw): straight apostrophes in the Undo payment box; staff see “No camps yet. An admin adds them.” on an empty camp list (§8 Empty states; admins keep “Add one with Add camp.”); a code comment in the camper history file updated now that Dashboard core’s v1.122 is live; the status file records the four checks the review asked for.
For testing: a small “fail the next read” helper in the preview’s fake Camps store, added to src/lib/mockClient.js (a shared file) so the Retry buttons can be tried.
How it was drawn: mock-x2-small-fixes.js and mock-c05-toast.js draw on top of the real preview; nothing in the app changed yet.

Your choice: OK all six, or change a point (say which number).
